Pemtumomab Profile Pemtumomab is a radiolabelled monoclonal antibody of murine origin that binds to muc-1, an epithelial cell surface protein on tumour cells. It has been investigated for the treatment of various cancers, including ovarian and gastric cancers, but results have been disappointing.
